## One report. Everything a price chart leaves out.

Order book, funding, liquidation zones and risk, calculated from live data and written up in a fixed structure on every scan.

### Key levels + live context

Support, resistance, volume profile, order-book walls, buy/sell pressure, funding rate and liquidation zones.

### Chart pattern detection

Flags common formations such as triangles, channels, and double tops and bottoms, with the levels that define them.

### Risk, quantified

A Monte Carlo risk estimate, volatility regime and higher-timeframe alignment to stress-test your thinking.

### A consistent report

Levels, liquidity, risk and news context in the same order on every scan, so you always know where to look.

## Six tools behind one login

Live scans, screenshot reads, 3D charts, watchlist scoring, a market gauge and a trading-habits review. Every plan includes all of them, and any report exports to PDF.

### Live Analysis

Order book, funding, liquidation zones, key levels and detected chart patterns, drawn on a live chart. Built for crypto.

### Screenshot Analysis

Upload any chart image from X, Discord or your platform, including forex and metals charts. Get a structured report with news and sentiment context.

### 3D MetaScan

Turn the chart into a 3D model. Drag to rotate, pinch to zoom, tap a candle to read it, and ask the AI about any section. Works on phones.

### Catalyst Scanner

Score a watchlist on seven signals, including volatility squeeze, volume and news catalysts. Switch between list and heatmap.

### Market Conviction

A market-wide gauge calculated from price trend, momentum, volume, Fear & Greed and fresh headlines, with every input shown.

### Trading Psychologist

Upload your trade history and get a Discipline Score with the evidence behind it. See it in action just below.

## Walk around your chart. Literally.

MetaScan rebuilds a flat chart as a 3D scene. Spin it, zoom into a cluster of candles, and ask the AI about any section you tap.

- Candles, volume and RSI stacked in separate 3D layers, with EMA 20 / EMA 50 and Bollinger bands on top

- Monte Carlo forecast fan drawn forward from the last candle, so you see the risk range in space

- Tap any candle for its open, high, low, close and volume

- Drag to rotate, pinch or scroll to zoom, two fingers to pan. Works on phones and tablets

- Drag rotate

- Wheel / pinch zoom

## Find out how you trade, not just what you trade.

Get a Discipline Score from 0 to 100. The numbers are calculated from your trades, and the AI only explains them.

- Win rate, payoff ratio, profit factor, loss streaks and trades per day

- Behavior flags such as overtrading, bigger size after losses and late-night trading, each with evidence

- Reads exports from Binance, Bybit, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, MetaTrader, TradingView and more, as CSV, Excel, pasted text or a screenshot

Each Psychologist report uses 10 credits.
